scoping.cycleTabs.editableUntil: The charter can be edited until the cycle is activated.
scoping.cycleTabs.frozen: Frozen when the cycle was activated.
scoping.cycleTabs.noCriteria: Not set. Criteria with a metric and a target are checked when the cycle closes.
scoping.cycleTabs.scopeFrozenServices: Activating snapshots the assets linked to the {n, plural, one {# in-scope service} other {# in-scope services}}. Link assets to those services under Business context first.
scoping.cycleTabs.scopeFrozenAll: No in-scope services are chosen, so activating snapshots every asset. Pick services in the charter to narrow it.
scoping.cycleTabs.scopeEmptyHint: The snapshot is empty. The in-scope services had no linked assets when the cycle was activated.
scoping.cycleTabs.profilesHint: Who this cycle assumes it defends against. The threat model reasons over the same profiles.
scoping.cycleTabs.noProfilesHint: Choose the attackers this cycle assumes: external, with stolen credentials, an insider, a supplier.
scoping.cycleTabs.notesSaveFailed: Failed to save scope refinement notes
scoping.cycleTabs.outcomePending: Evaluated when the cycle closes, against the success criteria of the charter.
scoping.cycleTabs.notesPrompt: What this cycle taught about scope: gaps to add, items to exclude, lessons for the next charter.
scoping.cycleTabs.notesLater: Recorded at review and close. The next cycle is created with them in view.
scoping.cycleTabs.notesDialogHint: What {name} taught about scope. Shown when the next cycle is created.
scoping.cycleTabs.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Add exposed RDP to scope next cycle. The legacy VPN exclusion held up.
scoping.charter.title: Cycle charter
scoping.charter.descriptionNamed: Scope charter for "{name}": attacker profiles, measurable success criteria, reasoned exclusions, escalation and roles.
scoping.charter.noPermission: You do not have permission to edit this charter.
scoping.charter.frozen: The charter is frozen. It can only be edited while the cycle is in planning, and activating the cycle locks it.
scoping.charter.scopeHint: Frame scope by what the cycle defends against.
scoping.charter.profilesHint: Who this cycle defends against. The threat model reasons over the same profiles.
scoping.charter.objectivesPlaceholder: e.g. Reduce KEV exposure on internet-facing assets
scoping.charter.prioritiesPlaceholder: e.g. Protect the customer payment platform
scoping.charter.riskSuccessHint: How much risk is acceptable and how success is measured.
scoping.charter.riskAppetitePlaceholder: e.g. No critical KEV exposures tolerated on internet-facing assets. Medium risk accepted internally.
scoping.charter.criteriaHint: Checked at close: name, metric and target
scoping.charter.metricsHelp: Metrics checked automatically when the cycle closes: MTTR, P0/P1 resolved, P0/P1 open, findings resolved/opened, validation coverage, risk reduction, risk after. Targets like "< 14 days", ">= 90%" or "0". Anything else is recorded as not measurable.
scoping.charter.exclusionsHint: What is deliberately out of scope, picked from the exclusions scans enforce, and the reason, so a deferral is a decision and not a silent gap.
scoping.charter.governanceHint: Who owns the cycle and where blockers escalate.
scoping.charter.escalationPlaceholder: Who blockers escalate to (person, role or channel).
scoping.cycles.cadence.weekly.label: Weekly triage
scoping.cycles.cadence.weekly.detail: Review new exposures, reprioritize and unblock owners.
scoping.cycles.cadence.monthly.label: Monthly steering
scoping.cycles.cadence.monthly.detail: Trend risk and SLA burn-down with sponsors, and adjust focus.
scoping.cycles.cadence.quarterly.label: Quarterly scope refresh
scoping.cycles.cadence.quarterly.detail: Revisit the charter and scope, and fold in the lessons of the last cycle.
scoping.lifecycle.activate.label: Activate
scoping.lifecycle.activate.title: Activate this cycle?
scoping.lifecycle.activate.body: Activating freezes the charter and snapshots the current asset scope (the assets of the in-scope services, or every asset when none is chosen). The scope cannot be changed afterwards.
scoping.lifecycle.review.label: Start review
scoping.lifecycle.review.title: Move to review?
scoping.lifecycle.review.body: The cycle stops taking new findings into scope and enters review. You can still close it afterwards.
scoping.lifecycle.close.label: Close cycle
scoping.lifecycle.close.title: Close this cycle?
scoping.lifecycle.close.body: Closing is irreversible: the charter success criteria are evaluated and the cycle and its scope snapshot become read-only.
